name: X-Linked Lymphoproliferative Disease Type 2

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: No standardized formal criteria; diagnosis based on clinical, laboratory, and genetic findings

criteria.description: Identification of pathogenic mutation in XIAP (BIRC4) gene
Clinical features consistent with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH), including fever, splenomegaly, cytopenias
Evidence of immune dysregulation such as hypogammaglobulinemia or defective apoptosis assays

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of pathogenic XIAP mutation plus clinical features consistent with HLH or immune dysregulation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of genetic testing with clinical and laboratory findings due to phenotypic variability.

common.notes: Enlarged spleen due to immune activation
Resulting from bone marrow involvement or HLH

occasional.notes: Enlarged liver due to immune activation

rare.notes: Secondary to HLH or CNS infiltration
Due to infection or immune-mediated inflammation

laboratory: Elevated ferritin and triglycerides consistent with HLH
imaging: Splenomegaly and hepatomegaly on abdominal ultrasound or CT
Possible pulmonary infiltrates on chest X-ray or CT
genetic: Pathogenic mutations in XIAP (BIRC4) gene confirmed by molecular genetic testing
other: Abnormal NK cell and cytotoxic T cell function tests

distinguishingFeatures: Mutation in SH2D1A gene instead of XIAP
Mutations in PRF1, UNC13D, STX11, or STXBP2 genes

redFlags: Rapid onset of fever with cytopenias and organomegaly
Signs of HLH including hyperferritinemia and coagulopathy
references: Marsh RA, et al. XIAP deficiency: a unique primary immunodeficiency best classified as X-linked familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis and not X-linked lymphoproliferative disease. Blood. 2010.
Rigaud S, et al. XIAP deficiency in humans causes an X-linked lymphoproliferative syndrome. Nature. 2006.
Jordan MB, et al. Familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis: update on diagnosis and pathogenesis. Hematology Am Soc Hematol Educ Program. 2011.
